The right lung base shows a hazy opacity, which is suggestive of collapsed lung tissue. The left lung base appears relatively clear.

It's important to note that this is a single image and a full assessment would require reviewing the entire chest X-ray, including the PA and AP views, as well as any clinical history. However, based on this single image, right base atelectasis is the most likely finding.
